FAA Statements on Aviation Accidents and Incidents

The information below is preliminary and subject to change. News media with questions on other topics may contact us at pressoffice@faa.gov.     

For General Aviation:

•    Contact local authorities for the names and medical conditions of anyone on board.   
•    A preliminary FAA report will be posted, usually on the next business day.
•    If known, the aircraft registration number (N-number) can be searched at the Aircraft Registry. 
•    If the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) is also investigating, it will provide all updates. 

For Commercial Aviation:

•    Contact the airline for information about passengers and crew, flights and schedules.
•    If the National Transportation Safety Board is also investigating, it will provide all updates.

November 10, 2026

Helicopter / Bayonne, New Jersey

A Bell 206 helicopter landed on a road in Bayonne, New Jersey, around 8:55 a.m. local time on Tuesday, Nov. 10, after the pilot reported a possible engine issue. Two people were on board. The FAA will investigate.

Investigation and Other Information 

November 9, 2026

Commercial Aviation / New Orleans, Louisiana

United Airlines Flight 2174 landed safely at Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport around 11:10 p.m. local time on Monday, Nov. 9, after the crew reported a passenger disturbance. The flight departed from Newark Liberty International Airport in New Jersey. The FAA will investigate. Contact the airline and local authorities for more information.

November 8, 2026

Commercial Aviation / Charleston, South Carolina

Wheels Up Flight 665 diverted safely to Charleston International Airport around 8:50 p.m. local time on Friday, Nov. 6, after the crew reported striking an alligator while departing from Charleston Executive Airport. The Embraer Phenom 300 was headed to Teterboro Airport in New Jersey. The FAA will investigate. Contact the operator for additional information. 

Investigation and Other Information 

General Aviation / Mayfield, Kentucky

An Aero Vodochody L39 crashed in a field in Mayfield, Kentucky, around 2:25 local time on Sunday, Nov. 8. Only the pilot was on board. The FAA and the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) will investigate. The NSTB will lead the investigation and provide any updates.

Investigation and Other Information 

General Aviation / Estero, Florida

A Kitfox Supersport crashed in Estero, Florida, around 1:15 p.m. local time on Sunday, Nov. 8. Only the pilot was on board. The FAA will investigate.

Investigation and Other Information 

November 7, 2026

General Aviation / Santa Ana, California

A Cessna 172 was blown over while taxiing behind United Airlines Flight 2611 at John Wayne Airport in Santa Ana, California, around 2:30 p.m. on Saturday, Nov. 7. Two people were on board. The FAA will investigate. 

Investigation and Other Information 

General Aviation / Fort Myers, Florida

A Cessna 172 landed on a road in Fort Myers, Florida, around 11:45 a.m. on Saturday, Nov. 7, after the pilot reported an engine issue. Two people were on board. The FAA will investigate.

Investigation and Other Information 

November 6, 2026

Commercial Aviation / Los Angeles, California

Southwest Airlines Flight 3396 landed safely at Los Angeles International Airport around 12:25 p.m. local time after the crew reported an engine issue. The flight departed from John Wayne Airport in Santa Ana, California, and was headed to San Jose Mineta International Airport. The FAA will investigate. Please contact the airline for additional information.

Investigation and Other Information 

General Aviation / Waycross, Georgia

A Beechcraft BE35 crashed while departing from Waycross - Ware County Airport in Georgia around 11:15 a.m. local time on Friday, Nov. 6. Only the pilot was on board. The FAA and the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) will investigate. The NTSB will lead the investigation and provide any updates.

November 4, 2026

Helicopter / Miami, Florida

A Robinson R44 helicopter crashed in the water east of Miami Executive Airport in Florida around 11:15 a.m. local time on Wednesday, Nov. 4. Three people were on board. The FAA and the National Transportation Safety Board will investigate. The NTSB will lead the investigation and provide all updates.

Investigation and Other Information

General Aviation / New Smyrna Beach, Florida

A Beechcraft BE35 crashed near New Smyrna Beach Municipal Airport in Florida around 2:40 p.m. local time on Wednesday, Nov. 4. Only the pilot was on board. The FAA will investigate.

Investigation and Other Information

Helicopter / East Elmhurst, New York

The crew of a Bell 206 helicopter reported being illuminated by a green laser while flying at 1,500 feet altitude about five miles northwest of LaGuardia Airport. The FAA notified local authorities and will investigate the incident, which occurred around 6:15 p.m. local time Wednesday, Nov. 4. 

Investigation and Other Information

General Aviation / Phoenix, Arizona

A Cessna 414 landed gear-up at Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport around 7 p.m. local time Wednesday, Nov. 4. Five people were on board. The FAA will investigate.

November 3, 2026

Commercial Aviation / Phoenix, Arizona

American Airlines Flight 675 returned safely to Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport around 2:45 p.m. local time on Tuesday, Nov. 3, after the crew reported a brake issue. The Airbus A321 was traveling to Daniel K. Inouye International Airport in Hawaii. The FAA will investigate. Please contact the airline for more information.

Investigation and Other Information

General Aviation / Lake Ozark, Missouri

A Cirrus SR22 crashed in the Lake of the Ozarks State Park in Missouri around 2:15 p.m. local time on Tuesday, Nov. 3. Two people were on board. The FAA and National Transportation Safety Board will investigate. The NTSB will be in charge of the investigation and will provide further updates.

Investigation and Other Information

General Aviation / Ocotillo Wells, California

A Piper PA-22 crashed near Ocotillo Wells, California, around 9:20 a.m. local time on Tuesday, Nov. 3. Only the pilot was on board. The FAA and the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) will investigate. The NTSB will lead the investigation and provide any updates.

November 2, 2026

General Aviation / Crisfield, Maryland

A Sonex crashed while attempting to land at Crisfield-Somerset County Airport in Maryland around 6 p.m. local time on Monday, Nov. 2. Only the pilot was on board. The FAA will investigate. 

Investigation and Other Information

General Aviation / San Jose, California

A Cessna T210N landed safely at San Jose Mineta International Airport around 11:50 a.m. local time on Monday, Nov. 2, after the crew reported windshield and engine issues. The number of people onboard is unknown. The FAA will investigate. 

Investigation and Other Information

Commercial Aviation / Orlando, Florida

Air Canada Rouge Flight 1670 landed safely at Orlando International Airport around 9:35 a.m. local time Monday, Nov. 2, after the crew reported a possible flap issue. The Airbus A321 departed from Toronto Pearson International Airport. The FAA will investigate. Please contact the airline for more information.

November 1, 2026

General Aviation / Cresthaven, Florida

A Learjet 60 crashed in a residential area near Cresthaven, Florida, around 12:50 p.m. local time on Sunday, Nov. 1. Nine people were on board. The aircraft departed Austin-Bergstrom International Airport in Texas and was headed to North Eleuthera Airport in the Bahamas. The FAA and National Transportation Safety Board will investigate. The NTSB will be in charge of the investigation and will provide all updates.

Investigation and Other Information

October 31, 2026

Commercial Aviation / Winchester, Virginia

United Airlines Flight 1791 landed safely at Washington Dulles International Airport after the crew reported being illuminated by a blue laser while flying at 9,500 feet altitude about five miles southeast of Winchester Regional Airport. The FAA notified local authorities and will investigate the incident, which occurred around 9:30 p.m. local time Saturday, Oct. 31. 

October 30, 2026

General Aviation / Waimea, Hawaii

A Gippsland GA-8 crashed in a field in Waimea, Hawaii, around 9 a.m. local time on Friday, Oct. 30. Five people were on board. The FAA will investigate.

Investigation and Other Information

October 29, 2026

Helicopter / McMinnville, Oregon

A Robinson R22 helicopter and an Airbus H125 helicopter collided in mid-air near McMinnville Municipal Airport in Oregon around 2:15 p.m. local time on Thursday, Oct. 29. Only the pilot was on board the R22,  two people were on board the H125. The FAA and National Transportation Safety Board will investigate. The NTSB will be in charge of the investigation and will provide further updates.

Investigation and Other Information
